generated_by: manual live probe, 2026-08-22 (scripts/… not committed; 8 arXiv ids)
question: Does arxiv.org/html actually yield a usable body, and what does top-5 selection cost?

coverage.caveat: n=8. A point estimate on eight papers is not a coverage figure; it is a sanity check that the path works at all.

refused.why: TRAP 1 fired on exactly the paper the plan named for it: arxiv.org/html/1412.6980 answers HTTP 200 with a short conversion-error page. Abstaining on status code would have read that page as the paper and concluded the source says nothing.

selection_cost_tokens.note: Top-5 selection is far cheaper than the plan's 1,016-token estimate because only sentences scoring above zero are kept. The abstract path it replaces was estimated at 1,125.

bug_found_and_fixed: The first version cut the body at the FIRST block matching references/acknowledgements. On arXiv that is site chrome at block 40 of 441, leaving 3 sentences and 19 words, so every paper was refused and coverage measured 0/8. This is the SECOND time this pipeline has cut a document at the first false bibliography heading — the other silenced D4 over 99.5% of a paper on 2026-08-21. The cut is now the last qualifying heading past the halfway point.
not_measured: Whether full-text evidence changes D1's VERDICTS. That needs model calls against labelled data and has not been run, which is why REVIEW_FULLTEXT_ENABLED defaults to off.
